title: Asian Style BBQ Sauce
ldCategory: Main Course, Sauces and Condiments, Side Dish
ldKeywords: asian barbecue sauce, barbecue sauce, dipping sauce
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 cup Stubbs Original BBQ Sauce ((or your favorite store bought sauce))
2 teaspoons Asian chili garlic sauce like Huy Fong or sambal oelek
ldInstructionsRaw: Prep. Combine all ingredients in a serving bowl. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve. Use as you would any other BBQ sauce.
